# Danish-Japanese Lessons

> A free, static, mobile-first web app that teaches Danish speakers to read Japanese from zero prior knowledge.

Danish-Japanese Lessons teaches reading Japanese (Japanese) with Danish as the language of instruction. It assumes no spoken, written, or reading knowledge, while also serving heritage speakers and hesitant readers. Orientation explains right-to-left reading and the two pronunciation guides before the recommended alphabet, personal-name, and first-reader vocabulary sequence. Every app-owned Japanese item has Danish help, Danish-friendly pronunciation, and standard Tehrani IPA. Lessons stay freely reachable; short deterministic puzzle breaks are optional and use only material already introduced.

The project is purely static: no backend, no database, no accounts. Progress is stored in the browser's localStorage. The landing site is published in three languages on GitHub Pages, and the React app is live at /app/ on the same site.

## Site

- [English](https://cocodedk.github.io/Danish-Japanese-Lessons/): what the app teaches and who it is for
- [Dansk](https://cocodedk.github.io/Danish-Japanese-Lessons/da/): the Danish page, written for the primary audience
- [فارسی (Japanese)](https://cocodedk.github.io/Danish-Japanese-Lessons/ja/): the Japanese page, right-to-left
